title: Gallery - Private Photo Vault
summary: Private gallery to lock, hide, and protect your photos & videos.
description:
Secure Gallery, Photo & Video Vault

Keep your photos, videos, and albums organized and private with this gallery app for Android. This app helps you manage, hide, and protect your media safely and efficiently.

🌟 Key Features of Gallery app:

Photo Album & Video Viewer

Easily view and navigate through all your images, videos, and Photo albums.

Zoom, rotate, and swipe through photo albums easily.

Private Photo Vault & Video Locker

Hide pictures and videos with a PIN.

Create private folders to hide personal media.

Keep your private albums safe using this photo vault and album locker.

Photo & Video Editor

Crop, rotate, and trim images and videos in the Photo Gallery app.

Apply filters, adjust contrast, and edit images and videos before sharing.

Create collages using the built-in collage maker.

Gallery Management & Photo Organizer

Sort photos and videos by date, name, size, or type, just like a photo organizer.

Identify and remove duplicate or similar media to free up storage.

Easily manage deleted photos and videos with a trash folder.

Photo Albums & Collections

Easily create, rename, and manage photo albums with this photo lock app.

Protect albums with a vault for full privacy.

Access your gallery, photo vault, and album locker anytime, fully private and secure. Organize photos and videos, hide sensitive media, and manage your albums effortlessly. Navigate your gallery quickly and manage all your photos and videos efficiently.

🔐 Why Choose This Gallery App?

Gallery App for Android: Simple layout for quick access to photos, videos, and albums.

Photo Vault & Private Vault: Secure your private photos and videos in a secret photo vault and easily use it as your own private photo album vault lock.

Photo Album Organizer: Manage and create photo albums easily.

Hide Photos & Videos: Keep media safe from unwanted access using the photo lock app.

Gallery Cleaner & Storage Manager: Free up space and organize your device.

Download this gallery vault to hide pictures and organize, protect, and enjoy your media in a secure, private, and easy-to-use photo vault and album organizer.
